title: Observe finite pre-accept buffering
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.failure_hypothesis: Finite peer sends before caller accept may buffer; this observation cannot establish a capacity or backpressure contract.
preconditions: Exact candidate binary and pinned implementation/source/profile hashes; independently reviewed ordinary-WebSocket scope and case oracle
Fresh disposable caller and recipient DOs in separately observed owned processes with actual root/isolate/process identities
Already enforced external wall/memory/PID/CPU ceilings and exclusive parent run slot; no deployment or launch by adapter
Public WebSocket/WebSocketPair and ordinary valid private-network upgrades; preflight echo and clean-close control must complete before entry
Case-specific initial state and options are established by the explicit W023 trace; no state or socket is reused from another case.
trace: Obtain but do not accept upgraded socket
Server sends16384-byte binary and text tail
Complete independent socket and witness server send calls before accept
Record any visible bufferedAmount and delivered count without asserting values
Accept, verify finite exact delivery, clean-close both
contract.stress: One fetch-upgrade remains unaccepted while two server frames are queued and independent peer completes.
contract.oracle: Exact eventual data/close is checked; queue amount and before-accept event behavior are nonpromoting observations
contract.cleanup: Every trace normal-closes its sockets; finally cleanup independently aborts control requests, accepts any already obtained pending upgrade for closure, closes every local endpoint, discards held echoes, closes recipient sockets, joins normalization and records unresolved resources. Separately owned supervisor must reap only owned processes/sockets and destroy fresh storage. Any incomplete cleanup or unknown entry is BLOCKED/FAIL, never PASS.
contract.distinctness: Characterization of accept gating; no OOM, indefinite producer or TCP pause.
